extracted.intended_audience: writers interested in entering the NYC Midnight Short Story Challenge (aspiring and experienced short story writers)
extracted.subtask_description: Writing original short stories for the NYC Midnight Short Story Challenge, a time-limited international competition that assigns genres and awards winners. Entrants produce short fiction under the event's constraints (often within 24 hours) and submit for judging and prizes.
